Accelerate Bench task · Numerics, tensors & graphs

The HPCG-derived task solves sparse linear systems on a structured grid.

Task version12.1.0CPU budget4 CPUsMemory6 GiBAgent budget8 hoursHarbor HubOpen task ↗

Workload

The program constructs the prescribed stencil matrix and solves for both supplied right-hand sides.

Correctness

Both full solution vectors must be finite, satisfy the error and residual bounds and reproduce the same values on a repeated run.

Timing

Timing includes reading the input, constructing the matrix, solver setup, both solves and writing the solutions.
